description: 慧经营 Text2SQL 固定评测集：50 个业务语义原型 × 10 种自然语言表达 = 500 条。

cases.core: 2026年8月1日至8月31日各店铺支付销售额，并按支付销售额降序
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.shop_name AS shop_name, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS paid_sales FROM fact_trade_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE o.pay_time >= '2026-08-01' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-01' AND o.order_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY s.shop_name ORDER BY paid_sales DESC, shop_name ASC
